Bhagwan bada ya karm bada? 🤔

Yeh sawaal har us insaan ke mann mein aata hai jo apni life ka purpose dhoondh raha hai. Chahe aap student ho, job kar rahe ho ya business, ek din yeh sawaal zaroor uthta hai: “Meri life ka asli maksad kya hai?”

Jyotish kehta hai, iska answer aapki kundli mein chhupa hai. Surya, aapka lagna aur 10th house batate hain ki aapki aatma is janm mein kya karne aayi hai. ☀️

Apna Soul Purpose Report chahiye?
Form fill karo aur apni sahi birth details mention karo (date, time, place)
